blurb:
Discover the best of San Antonio on a 7-hour guided tour from Austin with hotel pick-up and drop-off included. 

Upon arrival in San Antonio, your first stop is the legendary Alamo, where your expert guide brings history to life. Walk through the courtyard, learn about the pivotal 1836 Battle of the Alamo, and see original fortifications and weapons such as the 16-pounder cannon and barracks.

Next, head to the Tower of the Americas. Ride the high-speed elevator 750 feet to the observation deck—the tallest in Texas—for sweeping panoramic views of the San Antonio skyline and beyond.

Then enjoy a San Antonio River Walk Cruise, gliding along the city’s 15-mile urban waterway. See landmarks like La Villita, Old Mill Crossing, and the romantic Selena’s Bridge, while learning about San Antonio’s culture, history, and architecture.

Finally, your guide will drive you back to your hotel in downtown Austin, leaving you with unforgettable memories of this immersive Texan experience.
